Paint glowing orange sacs and veins at bright orange emissive color, with no bloom, halos or light cast on nearby materials. No background, no floor, no ground plane, no shadow catcher, no text.
Return one PNG at exactly 1024 x 1024 with a genuinely transparent background and the guide's original alpha silhouette. Do not resize the return.
